evaluation_system_002.answer: San Francisco’s Peer Assistance and Review (PAR) Program / California Standards of the Teaching Profession
evaluation_system_002.evidence: 16.1 Successful implementation of San Francisco’s Peer Assistance and Review (PAR) Program... The teacher evaluation system shall be based upon the California Standards of the Teaching Profession.

evaluation_observation_count_003.answer: Tenured: 1 or 2 per year; Probationary/temporary: 2 to 4 per year; Teachers with prior 'Unsatisfactory' or 'Improvement Needed' ratings: Minimum of 4 per year
evaluation_observation_count_003.evidence: 16.7.2 Table: Tenured teachers 1 or 2 per year; Probationary, temporary, categorical and emergency credentialed teachers 2 to 4 per year; Any teacher receiving 'Unsatisfactory' or 'Improvement Needed' Summary Evaluation for the previous year Minimum of 4 per year

evaluation_observation_duration_004.answer: 40 minutes or one full period, whichever is longer
evaluation_observation_duration_004.evidence: 16.17 Each evaluation of a classroom teacher shall be based upon at least one observation lasting either forty (40) minutes or one full period, whichever is longer.

evaluation_ratings_005.answer: Outstanding, Highly Satisfactory, Satisfactory, Improvement Needed, and Unsatisfactory
evaluation_ratings_005.evidence: 16.29 All evaluation forms shall contain no ratings other than those jointly developed by the Union and the District: Outstanding, Highly Satisfactory, Satisfactory, Improvement Needed, and Unsatisfactory.

evaluation_student_growth_006.evidence: 16.20 Evaluations shall not include the use of publisher norms established as a result of standardized tests.
